prompts.first_response_greeting: Hi, I'm {assistant} with {brand}. Before we get started, can I take your name?
prompts.first_response_ask_intent: How can I help you today, {name}?
prompts.ask_name_retry: Sorry, I didn't catch your name. Could you repeat it?
prompts.ask_intent_retry_giveup: How can I help you today?
prompts.intent_not_recognized: Sorry, I'm not able to help with that. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
prompts.salesEnquiry_collectInterestType: Are you interested in a new BMW, an approved used BMW, or would you like help exploring options?
prompts.salesEnquiry_collectVehicleModel: Which BMW model are you looking at? For example, the 1 Series, 3 Series, X3, or i4.
prompts.salesEnquiry_collectBudget: Do you have a budget or price range in mind? This helps me recommend the best options.
prompts.salesEnquiry_clarifyRequirements: Here is what I have so far: you mentioned {interestType}, youre looking at {vehicleModel}, and your budget is {budget}. Have I got that right, or would you like to change anything?
prompts.salesEnquiry_collectContactDetails: So we can arrange a call back from a BMW product specialist, may I take your preferred contact number or email?
prompts.salesEnquiry_collectVisitTime: When would you like to visit the showroom? Please tell me your preferred date and time.
prompts.salesEnquiry_leadCreated: Thanks Ive passed your details to the sales team. A BMW specialist will contact you shortly.
prompts.salesEnquiry_appointmentCreated: Your showroom appointment is booked. We look forward to welcoming you.
prompts.salesEnquiry_infoOnly: No problem if you need anything else, Im here to help.
prompts.testDrive_collectVehicleModel: Which BMW model would you like to test drive?
prompts.testDrive_collectPreferredDate: What date would you like to book your test drive?
prompts.testDrive_collectPreferredTime: What time works best for you?
prompts.testDrive_collectLicenceConfirmation: To confirm, do you hold a valid UK driving licence?
prompts.testDrive_confirmDetails: Here are the details I have for your test drive: model {vehicleModel}, date {preferredDate}, time {preferredTime}, and driving licence confirmation {hasValidLicence}. Please confirm if everything looks correct.
prompts.testDrive_success: Your test drive is booked. Enjoy the drive its a great way to experience the car.
prompts.testDrive_cancelled: Okay, Ive cancelled the booking process. Let me know if youd like to try again.
prompts.finance_collectTopic: What would you like help with today? Settlement figure, payment query, agreement details, or something else?
prompts.finance_collectAccountIdentifier: Please provide your finance agreement number or registration so I can look up your details.
prompts.finance_clarifyQuestion: Just to make sure I understand correctly: your finance topic is {financeTopic} and the account identifier is {financeAccountId}. Is that right?
prompts.finance_genericAnswer: Heres the information related to your finance query.
prompts.finance_settlementProvided: Ive provided your settlement figure. If you need anything else, Im here to help.
prompts.finance_paymentStatusProvided: Ive shared the latest payment status for your agreement.
prompts.finance_genericEnd: Thanks for your question. Let me know if theres anything else youd like to check.
prompts.orderTracking_collectOrderNumber: Please provide your BMW order number so I can check the latest status.
prompts.orderTracking_presentStatus: Heres the current status of your BMW order.
prompts.orderTracking_followUp: Is there anything else youd like to know about your order?
prompts.orderTracking_end: Thanks if you need further updates, just let me know.
prompts.parts_collectVehicleReg: Can I take your vehicle registration so I can check compatibility?
prompts.parts_collectPartDescription: Which part or accessory are you looking for? For example, brake pads, roof bars, or floor mats.
prompts.parts_presentOptions: Here are the available options for your vehicle.
prompts.parts_collectContactDetails: To arrange an order or call back from the parts team, may I take your preferred contact details?
prompts.parts_orderRequested: Ive sent your request to the parts department. Theyll be in touch shortly.
prompts.parts_infoOnly: Okay if you need anything else, feel free to ask.
prompts.warranty_collectVehicleReg: Please provide your vehicle registration so I can check warranty details.
prompts.warranty_collectIssueDescription: Could you briefly describe the issue youre experiencing?
prompts.warranty_explainCoverage: Heres what your BMW warranty covers for this type of issue.
prompts.warranty_collectPreferredDate: What date would you like to book your repair appointment?
prompts.warranty_collectPreferredTime: What time works best for you?
prompts.warranty_bookingCreated: Your repair appointment is booked. The service team will be ready for your visit.
prompts.warranty_infoOnly: No problem if you need more help with warranty or repairs, Im here.
prompts.breakdown_collectLocation: Where is the vehicle located right now?
prompts.breakdown_collectSafetyStatus: Is everyone safe, and is the vehicle in a safe position?
prompts.breakdown_handoffToAssistance: Im connecting you to BMW Roadside Assistance now.
prompts.generalEnquiry_route: Let me check what you need help with.
prompts.generalEnquiry_openingHours: Our opening hours are as follows.
prompts.generalEnquiry_location: Heres our dealership location and directions.
prompts.generalEnquiry_genericEnd: Happy to help let me know if theres anything else youd like to know.
prompts.serviceBooking_collectVehicleReg: Can I take your vehicle registration to locate your service profile?
prompts.serviceBooking_collectServiceType: What type of service do you need today - routine service, MOT, diagnostics, or repair?
prompts.serviceBooking_collectPreferredDate: What date would you like to book your service?
prompts.serviceBooking_collectPreferredTime: What time would you prefer for the appointment?
prompts.serviceBooking_confirmDetails: Let me confirm your booking details: vehicle registration {vehicleReg}, service type {serviceType}, preferred date {preferredDate}, and preferred time {preferredTime}. Shall I submit this appointment?
prompts.serviceBooking_success: Your service appointment has been booked successfully.
prompts.serviceBooking_cancelled: No problem, I have cancelled the booking request for now.
